title: 第九章      山洞危机
content_zh:
时间悄然的流逝着，死亡森林中大队伍不停的穿梭着，一批批的人都派出往前探路……

    “大家过来看，这里有个山洞，”前去探路的人回来叫道。

    “走吧，我们此行的任务就在那里了，前往洞口！”杜狼笑了笑。

    “此行的任务到底是什么？山洞里到底有着什么？算了，想那么多干嘛，总之到了那里就知道了”琼霄心底一直嘀咕着……

    卧槽，这山洞这么深！站在洞口里面，琼霄不禁吓了一跳。

    “赶紧点起火把，我们要进去看看！”

    说着一行人点起火把，举着火把浩浩荡荡的走了进去……

    “大家快看，山壁上有油灯，快点燃油灯，”其中一人惊喜的喊着。

    随着一盏油灯被点亮，立刻引起了连锁反应一盏盏油灯接连亮了起来直通山洞深处。不一会儿山洞里变得明亮起来。

    这个地方有些古怪，必须小心为妙，琼霄暗暗道。

    可人算不如天算，事情并不像琼霄想的那么简单，“你，你，还有你俩，你们四个过去看看，”望着前面的道路，杜狼点了几人过去试试，看看有没有陷阱，这其中包括了琼霄，琼霄定睛一看，这三个还有他都是那天所招募的人员。现在琼霄开始有点明白了：这敢情是拿我们四个人当枪使啊！

    “杜狼就是毒狼啊，真是对得起这个名字啊！”此时的琼霄心中立刻对着杜狼判了死刑。

    “还楞着干嘛，还不赶紧过去！”看着琼霄不为所动的四人杜狼显得有些不耐烦。

    在杜狼的驱使下，琼霄和另外三个人不得不朝着洞里里深处走了过去。随着洞穴的渐渐深入，琼霄心里越发的不安。

    咻，咻！，“大家小心！”琼霄迫切话音刚落，深处突如其来的暗箭使得另外三人措手不及，“啊！”随着一声声惨叫，其他三人中箭而倒下。琼霄虽然躲过了多数的暗箭，可依旧是受了点轻伤。望着倒下三人绝望的眼神，琼霄随即回过了头阴沉的说道：“杜狼，你给我记住了，你千万别死在了山洞里，要不然我会很伤心的！”随后只身朝着更深处飞快而去。

    “追！”听得琼霄的话语杜狼微微一愣当即大吼了一声顺着琼霄前进的方向追了过去，“别让他跑了！赶紧追上！”前面又传来的杜狼的声音。

    “真是该死，被人当枪使了，差点命丧箭下！你要完成任？好，我让你完成任务！”琼霄愤恨道。此时的琼霄心里异常的郁闷，被招来的四人，如今就剩他一人了，“放心！我会为你们报仇的！”琼霄飞快的朝着山洞深处奔去……

    “这是什么药物？好生奇怪，”停下脚步的琼霄望着这株长的奇怪草药不禁饶了饶头。

    琼霄立即走了上去，刚想要把草药摘下，“把药留下，我定饶你不死！”一阵声音突兀的传了进来，来人正是杜狼。
content_en:
Time passed quietly, large teams kept shuttling through the Death Forest, and batches of people were sent forward to explore the way...

    "Everyone, come and take a look, there is a cave here," the man who went to explore the path called back.

    "Let's go, our mission for this trip is right there, let's go to the cave entrance!" Du Lang smiled.

    "What is the mission of this trip? What is in the cave? Forget it, why are you thinking so much? You will know when you get there." Qiong Xiao kept muttering in his heart...

    Damn it, this cave is so deep! Standing inside the cave entrance, Qiong Xiao couldn't help but be startled.

    "Hurry up and light the torch, we want to go in and have a look!"

    As he said that, the group of people lit torches and walked in grandly holding the torches...

    "Look, everyone, there is an oil lamp on the mountain wall. Light the oil lamp quickly," one of them shouted in surprise.

    As an oil lamp was lit, it immediately caused a chain reaction, and the oil lamps lit up one after another, leading to the depths of the cave. After a while, the cave became brighter.

    This place is a bit weird, so be careful, Qiong Xiao said secretly.

    But God is not as good as man, and things are not as simple as Qiong Xiao thought. "You, you, and you two, the four of you go over and have a look." Looking at the road ahead, Du Lang ordered a few people to try to see if there were any traps, including Qiong Xiao. Qiong Xiao took a closer look and found that these three and him were all the people recruited that day. Now Qiong Xiao began to understand a little bit: This dare is to use the four of us as gunmen!

    "Du Lang is a poisonous wolf, he really deserves this name!" At this time, Qiong Xiao immediately sentenced Du Lang to death in his heart.

    "Why are you still waiting? Why don't you hurry over!" Du Lang, the four of them, looked a little impatient when they saw Qiong Xiao being unmoved.

    Driven by Du Lang, Qiong Xiao and the other three people had to walk deeper into the cave. As the cave gradually deepened, Qiong Xiao became more and more uneasy.

    Whoosh, whoosh! , "Everyone, be careful!" Qiong Xiao said urgently, and the other three people were caught off guard by the sudden hidden arrows from deep. "Ah!" With screams, the other three people fell down after being hit by arrows. Although Qiong Xiao escaped most of the hidden arrows, he was still slightly injured. Looking at the desperate eyes of the three fallen people, Qiong Xiao immediately turned around and said gloomily: "Du Lang, please remember, you must not die in the cave, otherwise I will be very sad!" Then he quickly went deeper into the cave alone.

    "Chase!" Hearing Qiong Xiao's words, Du Lang was slightly startled, then roared and chased after Qiong Xiao in the direction he was heading, "Don't let him run away! Hurry up and catch up!" Du Lang's voice came from the front again.

    "Damn it! I was used as a weapon and almost died! Do you want to complete your mission? Okay, I'll let you complete your mission!" Qiong Xiao said angrily. At this time, Qiong Xiao felt extremely depressed. He was the only one left among the four people who had been recruited. "Don't worry! I will avenge you!" Qiong Xiao quickly ran towards the depths of the cave...

    "What kind of medicine is this? It's so strange," Qiong Xiao, who stopped, looked at the strange long herb and couldn't help but feel relieved.

    Qiong Xiao immediately walked up and was about to pick off the herbs, "Keep the medicine, and I will spare your life!" A sudden voice came in, and the person who came was none other than Du Lang.
